title: Technical SEO
description: Technical SEO covering keyword research, on-page optimization, structured data, sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical URLs, Core Web Vitals, page speed, and analytics with Google tools.
learning_outcomes: Understand SEO fundamentals and how search engines work

Optimize on-page elements: titles, meta descriptions, headers

Manage sitemaps, robots.txt, and canonical URLs
Monitor performance with Google Search Console and Analytics
